Cooperation with Sarajevo protected areas

Radoje Laušević · Jul 22, 2021 · Gardening, Sustainable Development Goals, Official Development Assistance, Sustainable Consumption & Production, Sustainable Lifestyles, Data Visualization, Project management

Public Enterprise for the Protected Natural Areas of the Kanton Sarajevo manages five areas: Nature Monument "VreloBosne", Nature Monument Skakavac, Protected Landscape Bentbaša, Protected Landscape "Trebević" and Protected Landscape "Bijambare". It has been a great pleasure to discuss with the director Mr Osman Delić, MSc, at a meeting in Sarajevo the possibilities of project co-operation the IPA CBC programme, the BlueDanube programme and the ongoing EXChAngE project the further development of the BluePass.

Radoje Laušević and Osman Delić (photo: private archive)

I look forward to continuing communication and developing concrete projects that contribute to the preservation of original natural values and the ambient diversity of protected areas.
